parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Desc
parameters.description: The description of the snapshot policy.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The ID of the policy to modify.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The status of the snapshot policy. Valid values:

- ENABLED
- DISABLED
